title: I can’t believe Wicked: For Good exists and is something I’ve seen wi...
transcript: Just got back from wicked for good. Some quick spoiler free thoughts. First of all, I cannot believe this exist. Now we have parts one and 2 2. Overall I really, really, really enjoyed it. I do think that there's a lot of criticisms about the film. Most of them are criticisms that I already have about wicked act 2 in general. There were some things that I think the film does improve upon, and some things where it being in film kind of exacerbated the issues with the the second act of Wicked The Musical. But overall my favourite parts of Wicked Act 2 are also my favourite parts of wicked for good. The new songs are fine. I. I don't think I'm gonna listen to either of them, but I see kind of what they were doing with both of the new songs. What I really loved, however, were the adjustments that they made to already existing songs. And I won't tell you what they are, but there is a lot of them and for the most part I really loved the changes. I am excited to go see it again because I think one of my biggest issues issues was getting used to the pacing, which felt like a little off. And I also thought the same thing when I saw part 1 for the first time. But again, I think it's a challenge because the pacing in Act 2 of wicked is also weirdly off. Um. But for the most part, I really love especially the first half of the film and what they've added to the story. I do wish that they'd added a little bit more to the ending, and they've added some really great stuff. I wish. I wish we've gotten just. Just a tad bit more of the second half of the film fleshed out. Highlights for me are the opening sequence, as long as you're mine and no Good Deed, which are also highlights for me in the stage show. I also loved some of the expansion of Nessa's story in this. And my least favourite thing hands down is the Scarecrow character design. I just thought that the character design itself was kind of awful, especially when we have two really great Scarecrow character designs in both the Wiz and The Wizard of Oz. Um, so that. That was the only major miss for me. Everything else, I'm either lukewarm or highly enjoyed it. Overall, however, I really loved this film and I cannot wait to go see it again. I will say, go in with proper expectations, I wouldn't consider this like an Oscar contender. But if you like wicked the musical, you're going to mostly like what wicked for good is presenting to you. Overall, it's not a full fix, but I definitely think it's an improvement.
